Also, the RSI indicator is also showing some bearishness as it is below 50, but is showing some upward momentum. Overall, the stock is probably going to stay bearish, but with a risk level of 2. I would recommend HOLDING and waiting to see if the upward trend continues, or if the price is rejected at the above-mentioned resistance levels.
